# gpupaas_workspace (Resource)

GPU PaaS workspace within a project (`apiVersion: gpupaas.ai/v1alpha1`, `kind: Workspace`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gpupaas_workspace" "team_a" {
  metadata = {
    name    = "team-a"
    project = gpupaas_project.demo.metadata.name
    labels = {
      env = "dev"
    }
  }

  spec = {
    display_name = "Team A"
    description  = "Shared workspace for Team A"
  }
}

# Import example (project-scoped):
# terraform import gpupaas_workspace.team_a demo/team-a
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Workspaces are project-scoped: <project>/<name>.
terraform import gpupaas_workspace.team_a demo/team-a
```
